params.prompt: Create ONE original logo concept for Berth, a self-hosted Android emulator fleet for AI agents and humans. The concept is a safe assigned dock for a borrowed device. Produce a professional isolated brand logo, with one symbol above one wordmark except for the typographic option. The only text must be Berth (or berth when specified). Center on a pure white square canvas with generous margins. Keep the full lockup within the central 70 percent. Flat vector artwork, crisp paths, recognizable small silhouette. No mockups, photographs, shadows, textures, explanatory labels, taglines, watermarks, multiple alternatives, or famous-brand imitation. Elegant monoline identity. One continuous evenly weighted navy line draws a docking cradle flowing into an upright device outline, subtly suggesting lowercase b. Very few bends, rounded terminals, ample negative space, one small turquoise connection point. Navy #18374B and turquoise #22B8AA. Light but confidently readable lowercase berth wordmark.
